execution.progress: hum or sing voices one segment per round and continues with the same action until the requested rounds are voiced; resume continues a paused bout; cancel takes one round. Voiced segments persist across pauses.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds at 0.2 energy each; each hums a short practice phrase heard nearby (silent in pain or distress). hum or sing: rounds 1-3 (default 1), 0.5 energy per voiced round, no material. phrase: 2-8 notes {pitch: -4..4 steps from the home note 0, beats: 1-4}, or improvise=true. sing may add text (at most 240 characters, as tell). Shared by study, hum and sing: at most 3 voiced rounds in any 10 rounds, and 2 unvoiced rounds after 3 voiced rounds in a row or in one bout; a start must fit every requested round. Checked at start and each round: alive; no pain (an injury in the last round) or distress (satiety 0, body temperature below 7 or above 34); at least 0.5 energy. A refused start or resume costs nothing. resume continues a paused bout after fresh checks; cancel takes one round and no energy; both use only mode.
details.effects: Each voiced round is one segment at your position: everyone else living within 5 units (tell's hearing radius), seen or not, gets a heard event and heard-list entry with your mode, phrase, words and segment. Silence, refusals and pauses are not heard. The sound ends with each segment; no object, item, mark or lasting sound is made. Another action, a refused round, too little energy, a limit, pain or distress pauses the bout without charge; voiced segments and their energy are never refunded. Death ends the bout and any study. improvise=true derives 4-6 notes from your id and the start round (FNV-1a and xorshift32; from 0, steps of -2..+2 within -3..+3, back to 0), never at random. No reward, mood change or practice milestone; listeners get only the heard entry, and no reaction is implied.

execution.progress: sample pays and records one round at a time with the same action up to sampleRounds; each after reading is taken at the next round start. resume continues a paused trial; inspect, compare, inspect-progress and cancel take one round.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect: 1 round, 0.2; targetId (visible object or item) or x, y (visible point within 5), or neither for a survey. sample: only where you stand, sampleRounds 1-3 (default 1), 0.2 per sampled round; needs 0.2 energy, health 20+ and body 7-34 (activity guards, not safety); baselineId names an earlier record. compare: 1 round, 0.2, uses no sample. inspect-progress: 1 round, 0.2. resume: at the trial position, as sample. cancel: 1 round, no energy. Refusals cost nothing; nothing is used or given; travel is navigate.
details.effects: inspect gives your body and air readings (measured) and, here and at candidates (the nearest visible spot of each other ground kind and each visible enclosure interior, or the named one), model-derived air, indoor, light, insulation and next-round body change from the world's own update. Ground kind, time, weather, enclosure interiors (air pulled toward 12, insulation slowing change) and installed shelter or fire rules change exposure; trees, plants and rocks change no air, light or wind, so no shade is reported. sample records body temperature at each round's start and the next (measured), the prediction and the same-round open-soil value (model-derived). Trial end and compare label evidence, represented heat input, observed trend and body direction (cooling only if body temperature fell). Another action, moving or low energy pauses free; guards stop; death ends. No reward, buff, shelter or cooling.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Mechanical food separation
value.function: Open or cut your own food by hand or with your own stone where the represented material allows: open a hard shell in 0.1 blocks bare-handed or struck on a support, or cut a whole unit with a stone or flint edge on a support.
value.costs: Study: 3 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect: inputStackId (your own item), optional operation, quantity, implementId, supportId; 1 round, 0.2 energy, no food used; reports condition, structure, means, limits and unmet needs. trial: the same fields; round 1 is the setup (0.2) and reserves the portion, round 2 of the same action the working round (0.5): 0.7 energy a bout. open: quantity 0.1-1 in tenths (default the item, up to 1); cut: quantity 1. inspect-progress: 1 round, 0.2. resume does the unpaid working round after fresh checks; cancel: 1 round, no energy. Refusals cost nothing; getting a stone and travel are separate actions.
value.effects: open needs a represented shell (here hazelnut); each 0.1 block gets one squeeze or impact. Bare hands press with the bounded hand force of hand-break-food@1 over one unit; an implement (own whole rigid inedible piece) struck on a support (solid inedible object in reach, not a plant or animal, or another own piece on firm ground) passes the lower of their strengths (hardness / 10) x (1 - flexibility). At or below the shell strength nothing changes; above it damage (load - strength) / strength stays on the item: below 1 cracked and closed, at 1 open, then picked apart by hand into 0.1 kernel and 0.1 shell per block with the source origin, age and decay; the kernel keeps all food value; shell is not food. cut: a whole unit without a shell, an own stone or flint edge passing the world contact model (index 8+ and at least the food, radius 0.0002 or less, sound) and a support; one stroke parts it once more (up to 10 portions), still one unit with mass, food value and age unchanged, eaten whole; no offcut. peel is refused: no separable layer is represented. Wear: an implement no harder than what it meets, or a support softer by 0.5, loses 0.0001 kg per contact (2 at most per block or stroke); nothing breaks. Another action, lost reach or means or low energy pause before the working round; a changed portion ends the work; cancel or death releases it once. Safety, toxins and nutrition stay unknown; no refund or reward.
